characteristics.title: Efficacy and safety evaluation of intra-articular injection of tranexamic acid in total knee arthroplasty operation with temporarily drainage close.
characteristics.journal: International journal of clinical and experimental medicine
characteristics.study_design: Prospective randomized controlled study (parallel RCT); patients were randomly divided equally into experimental group (TXA group) and control group (placebo group)
characteristics.country: China (Shandong Provincial Hospital Affiliated to Shandong University, Jinan; Shandong Jiaotong Hospital, Jinan)
characteristics.population_description: 100 patients admitted to hospital who underwent primary unilateral total knee arthroplasty (TKA) from January 2012 to December 2014. Preoperative TXA group age 52.6 ± 12.4, control group age 53.2 ± 10.2; gender (male/female) 25/25 in TXA group and 22/28 in control group; BMI 26.23 ± 2.17 vs 25.62 ± 3.03; preoperative Hb 126.30 ± 10.65 vs 131.25 ± 12.29 g/L. Exclusion criteria: preoperative anemia or coagulopathy; infectious active diseases; TXA contraindications; history of venous thromboembolic disease; clotting problems (liver tumor/cirrhosis); intent to participate in autologous blood transfusion; incompatibility.
characteristics.intervention_description: For the TXA group, 1 g TXA was dissolved in 50 ml 0.9% sodium chloride solution and injected intra-articularly after prosthesis implantation but before cavity close. Conventional drainage clamping was carried out for 4 h and the drainage tube was removed 48 h postoperative. Anticoagulant therapy of 5000 iu low molecular weight heparin applied to both groups 8 h after operation.
characteristics.control_description: For the control group, similar measures were taken except that no TXA was dissolved in 50 ml 0.9% sodium chloride solution (placebo group).
characteristics.follow_up_duration: Lower extremity venous color Doppler ultrasound screening at 1 week after surgery to detect DVT; patients followed up regularly with INR monitoring. No specific end-of-follow-up time reported.
characteristics.funding: National Natural Science Foundation of China (No. 81271966)

study.quality_notes: Single-center prospective randomized controlled trial (100 patients, 50 per arm) of primary unilateral TKA. The intervention arm received 1 g tranexamic acid dissolved in 50 mL 0.9% saline injected intra-articularly (topically) after prosthesis implantation and before cavity closure, with drainage clamping for 4 h; the control arm received the same measures without TXA (placebo/saline). This is a topical (intra-articular) route only, so route_of_tranexamic_acid_administration = topical for all rows; no intravenous or combined-route arms are present. Total blood loss was calculated from preoperative and postoperative Hct/hemoglobin (Nadler formula); the exact postoperative sampling time used for the reported total is not fully specified in Table 2. P values in Table 2 are only reported as inequalities (p<0.05 / p>0.05) and are retained as inequalities, not exact values. The secondary VTE endpoint mismatch (asymptomatic screened DVT at 1 week vs protocol's symptomatic DVT/PE within 30 days) is flagged in the conflicts note of the DVT row; no pulmonary embolism events were reported in either arm.
